mechanics.name: Technician
mechanics.currentEffect: While repairing a Generator, reduces the audible range of all repair-related noises by 16 m. A failed Skill Check causes the Generator to lose 4/3/2% additional progress, but suppresses the Generator explosion and Loud Noise Notification normally triggered by that failed check.
activation: Be repairing a Generator; the quieter-noise effect applies during repair.
Fail a Skill Check to suppress the explosion and notification while incurring the tiered extra progress loss.
Ends/deactivates when: The effects apply only while repairing a Generator.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.1.0): Reduced repair noise range by 16 m instead of 8 m and reduced extra missed-check progress loss to 4/3/2% from 5/4/3%.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Makes Generator repair quieter and hides failed Skill Check alerts, but increases the progress lost when a check is missed.
specialInteractions: A failed Skill Check still loses extra Generator progress even though its explosion and Loud Noise Notification are suppressed.

editorial.summary: Generator repair noises are heard from 16 metres less far away; failed basic Skill Checks no longer explode or notify the Killer, but lose extra progress.
useCases: Repair more quietly behind walls or on indoor maps where the Killer listens for generators.
Prevent missed Skill Checks from broadcasting a Loud Noise notification.
Use as a beginner safety net while learning generator Skill Checks.
counters: Failed Skill Checks lose extra progress.
Experienced players should not be missing many standard generator checks.
The reduced repair-noise radius does not hide the generator's visual progress or direct line of sight.
pros: 10.1 doubled the noise-distance reduction to 16 metres.
Completely hides the explosion notification from a miss.
cons: Miss penalty still hurts the objective.
Value falls as Skill Check consistency and map awareness improve.
analysis: Technician ranks this position after its 10.1 buff because the quieter repair radius is now large enough to create real stealth value on indoor and line-of-sight-heavy maps. A Killer can pass much closer to a worked generator without receiving the normal audio cue.

The failed-check protection is beginner-friendly but should not be mistaken for efficiency. The explosion and Loud Noise notification disappear, yet the generator loses additional progress. A player who misses frequently is safer from detection while still costing the team time.

Experienced players get more value from the audio reduction than the miss protection. Finishing a risky generator behind walls can be easier when the Killer cannot hear the repair from the usual distance.

Technician remains C because it solves detection rather than repair speed and becomes less necessary with experience. It is a respectable teaching and stealth perk, not a long-term meta objective tool.
editorial.verdict: A much better stealth-generator perk after 10.1, but still mainly a comfort pick. Technician hides mistakes from the Killer, not from the generator's progress bar.
